purpose: Teach: 差益/守秘/ターボ/コストダウン/返上/行革/株券/引渡し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究費の為替差益も予算に組み込め
lines.en: Ren, factor the foreign exchange gains on the research fund into the budget.
lines.style: Direct but not harsh. Brisk instruction—he expects competence and assumes he'll get it. Clipped tempo. No wasted breath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。共同研究の守秘契約を確認しました
lines.en: Yes. I've confirmed the confidentiality agreement for the joint research project.
lines.style: Respectful, quiet attentiveness. Slightly formal register—deference to the senior. Careful precision in delivery, like checking each word before it lands.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文執筆のペースをターボに上げろ
lines.en: Ren, accelerate the pace on the paper. We need it done faster.
lines.style: Sharp, commanding. A tap of urgency on 'faster.' Expects immediate understanding. No elaborate explanation needed—he trusts Ren follows.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験のコストダウン案を提出しました
lines.en: Yes. I've submitted a cost reduction proposal for the experiments.
lines.style: Measured, earnest response. Slightly braced—offering concrete evidence of work. Tempo steady and formal, the register of someone reporting upward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、不採用ポストを丁寧に返上しろ
lines.en: Ren, politely decline the positions you didn't get. Handle it with grace.
lines.style: Firm, measured guidance. Not harsh—almost paternal in its directness. He's teaching as much as directing. Slight weight on 'politely,' modeling the tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会の行革にも貢献したいと考えております
lines.en: Yes. I'm thinking of ways to contribute to the conference's administrative reforms as well.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly formal. A trace of ambition underneath the politeness—showing initiative without overstepping. Quiet confidence, careful pacing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室の株券のような寄付権を活用しろ
lines.en: Ren, make use of the lab's donation rights—the research fund equivalent of equity.
lines.style: Instructive, assuming he understands the metaphor. Tempo steady. Not condescending. The tone of someone trusting his junior to grasp both the practical and strategic angle.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。試料の引渡し時期を学会と調整しました
lines.en: Yes. I've coordinated the sample handover timeline with the conference organizers.
lines.style: Assured, professional close. Quieter than before—a note of completion. Still respectful but with a subtle undertone of competence confirmed. Gentle fade.
